description: Eating alone, well, on purpose. The food is secondary and everyone present knows it.
energy_note: Nobody will remember what was served.

aspect: The preparation is part of it
description: Somebody thought about it in advance. That thought is doing a lot of the work, whether or not the cooking was any good.
Someone made it how you like it without asking. The specific pleasure is the evidence of attention rather than the flavour.
energy_note: They remembered how you take it.

description: People free at the same time in the same place. In this set of datasets that is not a small requirement: permits, shifts, borders and money all decide who can be at a table.
energy_note: The hard part is everyone being in one room.

description: Every later version of the meal is measured against this one, usually unfavourably, and that is fine.
energy_note: The version all the others are compared to.
